{"id":1836827667,"question_id":4126,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"8 months","timestamp":1763822820,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"0 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1836827667/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Minimum Number of Flips to Reverse Binary String","memory":"9.2 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    string binary(int n)\n    {\n        string ans = \"\";\n        while(n){\n            int digit = n % 2;\n            ans += digit + '0';\n            n /= 2;\n        }\n        reverse(ans.begin(), ans.end());\n    return ans;\n    }\n    int minimumFlips(int n) {\n        string num = binary(n);\n        string t = num;\n        reverse(num.begin() , num.end());\n        string m = num;\n        \n        int opr = 0;\n        int i=0 , j=0;\n        while(i < t.size() && j < m.size())\n            {\n                if(t[i] != m[j])\n                {\n                    opr++;\n                }\n                i++;\n                j++;\n            }\n        return opr;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"minimum-number-of-flips-to-reverse-binary-string","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1161}
